findings_addressed.oracle: Independent byte-wise computation: bytes(b ^ 0xAA for b in b'\xff\xff\xff\xff') == b'\x55\x55\x55\x55', encoded as '55555555'
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/bridges/hex_editor.py, change `result = pipeline.execute(data)` to `result = data` (skip XOR) — the assertion `result == '55555555'` fails because the unchanged 0xFF bytes encode as 'ffffffff'

findings_addressed.oracle: combined_key = 0x11 ^ 0x22 ^ 0x44 = 0x77 (non-zero); expected = binascii.hexlify(bytes(b ^ 0x77 for b in b'\x00\x11\x22\x33')).decode() = '77665544'; input hex '00112233' != expected '77665544', so a no-op pipeline cannot satisfy the assertion
findings_addressed.weakness_fixed: Previous keys 0xFF ^ 0x0F ^ 0xF0 = 0x00 caused combined key to be zero, making expected == hexlify(payload) == '00112233'; a silent no-op pipeline would also return '00112233' and incorrectly PASS
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/bridges/hex_editor.py, change pipeline step accumulation to apply only the first step (breaking multi-step chaining) — the assertion `result == '77665544'` fails because applying only XOR(0x11) to b'\x00\x11\x22\x33' yields '11002233'

findings_addressed.oracle: Independent per-byte XOR: bytes(b ^ 0x55 for b in range(16)) is fully determined without calling production code; all 32 hex characters must match exactly
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/bridges/hex_editor.py, change XOR key parsing to always use 0x00 instead of the provided hex key — the assertion fails because bytes(b ^ 0x00 for b in range(16)) != bytes(b ^ 0x55 for b in range(16))

notes: G0180 re-hardened: keys changed from (0xFF, 0x0F, 0xF0) whose XOR-combination was 0x00 (self-cancelling, no-op indistinguishable) to (0x11, 0x22, 0x44) whose XOR-combination is 0x77 (non-zero). Two inline assertions added: `assert combined_key != 0` and `assert expected != binascii.hexlify(payload).decode()` to permanently document and enforce the non-cancelling invariant. No production code modified.
